discrepancies: The owner's 14 received items exactly match tier 1 + tier 2 of the July 2023 rerun. Tier 3 (MythForce, 30 USD) was removed from the bundle ~8 hours after launch (per barter.vg), so by their purchase date (2023-07-29) tier 2 WAS the top tier — they bought the full available lineup. Differences vs the Sept/Oct 2022 original run: tiers there were 1/10/20 USD with Pathfinder: WotR EE in tier 3; the 2023 rerun moved Pathfinder into tier 2 and put MythForce in tier 3. Tier 2 also carried a 25% off Humble Store coupon for MythForce. Price paid 11.14 does not equal either the 12 USD or 10.88 EUR tier-2 minimum exactly; it is consistent with a EUR-denominated payment slightly above the EUR tier-2 minimum (currency of the recorded amount not established here).
